examples.vi: Sau khi phát hiện anh ta lừa dối, tôi buộc phải dứt khoát chia tay.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To ignite.

examples.en: Let's fire up the grill and have a barbecue.
examples.vi: Nhóm bếp nướng lên rồi mở tiệc thịt nướng nào.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To search for by rummaging, and then extract (an item from e.g. a container); to obtain.

examples.en: I fished out my keys from the bottom of my bag.
examples.vi: Tôi lục đáy túi lấy chùm chìa khóa ra.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

examples.en: The recluse did not fit in at the party.
examples.vi: Con người sống khép kín ấy không hòa nhập được ở bữa tiệc.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be of similar cultural or social status as the members of a group of people.

translations.text: hòa nhập được với nhóm người

examples.en: As a retired sergeant, you should fit into the crowd at the officers' club.
examples.vi: Là trung sĩ đã nghỉ hưu, hẳn bạn sẽ hòa nhập được với mọi người ở câu lạc bộ sĩ quan.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be able to be assembled in this way.

examples.en: None of these pieces fit together. Are they really from the same jigsaw puzzle?
examples.vi: Chẳng mảnh nào khớp nhau cả. Chúng có đúng là cùng một bộ xếp hình không?

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To direct or focus one's attention on (a goal); to decide on (a goal); to fixate on (something).

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To repair or refurbish.

examples.en: I've been fixing up the boat for the holidays.
examples.vi: Tôi đang sửa sang lại con thuyền để chuẩn bị cho kỳ nghỉ.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To complete; to create details from a basic outline, structure, or skeleton.

examples.en: The model shows the basics, but we still need to flesh out the details.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To browse rapidly.

examples.en: I was flicking through the newspaper when I glimpsed a funny headline.
examples.vi: Tôi đang lật lướt tờ báo thì thoáng thấy một dòng tít buồn cười.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be nearby or available.

examples.en: Try looking in the office: there should be a few pens floating around there.
examples.vi: Thử tìm trong văn phòng xem, chắc có vài cây bút nằm đâu đó trong ấy.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To pass or go past quickly, often without much interaction

examples.en: I like to sit and watch the world fly by.
examples.vi: Tôi thích ngồi ngắm dòng đời trôi vùn vụt.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To erupt in an emotional outburst.

examples.en: He flew into a rage when he saw that.
examples.vi: Anh ta nổi cơn thịnh nộ khi thấy cảnh đó.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To coat, or become coated, with condensation. To steam up.

examples.en: My glasses fogged up when he opened the shower door.
examples.vi: Kính của tôi mờ hơi nước khi anh ấy mở cửa phòng tắm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To go out of business; to stop doing something.

examples.en: That place folded up years ago.
examples.vi: Chỗ đó đóng cửa dẹp tiệm từ nhiều năm trước rồi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To take further actions remaining after an event; to continue, revisit, or persist; especially, to maintain communication or verify.

translations.text: theo sát, tiếp tục xử lý

examples.en: Send a letter, then follow up promptly with a telephone call.
examples.vi: Gửi thư trước, rồi nhanh chóng gọi điện tiếp theo.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To engage in frivolous behaviour; to monkey around.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To abandon a dearly held desire, or a familiar comfort, under pressure from an inescapable stronger party.

examples.en: If you're not at work in 15 minutes you can forget about ever coming back.
examples.vi: Nếu 15 phút nữa anh không có mặt ở chỗ làm thì khỏi cần quay lại nữa.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To freeze on the surface.

examples.en: The lake in the park freezes over every winter.
examples.vi: Mùa đông nào mặt hồ trong công viên cũng đóng băng.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: (of machines and software) To come or bring to a sudden halt, stop working (functioning).

examples.en: Since the last update, the program freezes up after a few minutes of use.
examples.vi: Từ bản cập nhật vừa rồi, chương trình cứ dùng vài phút là bị treo.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To wash or groom oneself in order to be more attractive.

translations.text: rửa ráy chỉnh trang cho tươm tất

examples.en: Women spend longer than men at freshening up before going out.
examples.vi: Phụ nữ chỉnh trang trước khi ra ngoài lâu hơn đàn ông.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To disapprove of.

examples.en: This town frowns at scandalous behavior.
examples.vi: Thị trấn này không ưa lối cư xử tai tiếng.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To gather, assemble or collect, usually into a group or mass.

examples.en: Beatrice gathered up the hem of her petticoat.
examples.vi: Beatrice túm gọn gấu váy lót lên.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To advance toward success.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To take preemptive action before a potential development becomes reality.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To survive; to do well enough.

examples.en: She didn't have a lot of money, but she had enough to get along.
examples.vi: Cô ấy không có nhiều tiền, nhưng cũng đủ sống.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To move to the other side of (something, such as an obstruction) by deviating from a direct course or following a curved path.

examples.en: The tide was too high, and we couldn't get around the rocks.
examples.vi: Nước triều quá cao, chúng tôi không đi vòng qua mấy tảng đá được.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To eventually begin or return to some task.

translations.text: rốt cuộc cũng bắt tay vào làm

examples.en: Someday I'll get around to organizing this mess.
examples.vi: Rồi sẽ có ngày tôi chịu dọn đống bừa bộn này.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To take a break from one's present circumstances; to journey (to), especially on holiday.

examples.en: This place is really getting me down. I need to get away for a while.
examples.vi: Nơi này làm tôi chán nản quá. Tôi cần đi đâu đó một thời gian.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To get away, or escape, taking (something) with one.

examples.en: The thieves got away with a million pounds' worth of jewellery.
examples.vi: Bọn trộm cuỗm đi số nữ trang trị giá một triệu bảng.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Return to where one came from.

examples.en: When I get back from holiday, I expect the house to be tidy.
examples.vi: Khi tôi đi nghỉ về, tôi mong nhà cửa gọn gàng.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To retaliate against; to take revenge on.

examples.en: She put toothpaste in his shoes to get back at him for the frog he left in her refrigerator.
examples.vi: Cô ấy bơm kem đánh răng vào giày anh ta để trả đũa vụ con ếch trong tủ lạnh.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To return contact with (someone); to return to someone in response to a request.

examples.en: I'll get back to you when I have an answer.
examples.vi: Khi nào có câu trả lời, tôi sẽ báo lại cho bạn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To support, to cheer on.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To subsist; to succeed, survive, or manage, at least at a minimal level.

examples.en: Do you think they can get by on only one salary?

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To duck or take cover, usually to avoid harm. Commonly used as a caution or warning in the imperative.

examples.en: With bullets flying, all I could do was get down and pray.
examples.vi: Đạn bay vèo vèo, tôi chỉ biết nằm rạp xuống và cầu nguyện.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To start focusing on doing something serious

translations.text: bắt đầu nghiêm túc tập trung vào

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To secure membership at a selective school.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To move into (an object), such that one ends up inside it.

examples.en: She got into the car.
examples.vi: Cô ấy lên xe.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To reserve or have a period of time as a vacation from work.

examples.en: She managed to get a week off in March to go to Paris.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã xin nghỉ được một tuần vào tháng Ba để đi Paris.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To proceed with; to begin or continue, especially after an interruption.

examples.en: Turn off the television and get on with your homework.
examples.vi: Tắt tivi đi và làm tiếp bài tập về nhà đi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To contact a person or organisation about a particular matter.

translations.text: liên hệ để giải quyết việc

examples.en: You should get onto the manufacturers and complain.
examples.vi: Bạn nên liên hệ với nhà sản xuất mà khiếu nại.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To spend free time out of the house.

examples.en: You work too hard. You should get out more.
examples.vi: Bạn làm việc nhiều quá. Nên ra ngoài chơi nhiều hơn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To leave, exit or escape from; to become free of.

examples.en: All the occupants managed to get out of the burning building.
examples.vi: Tất cả người bên trong đã thoát được khỏi tòa nhà đang cháy.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To get through a difficult time; to overcome a source of grief.

translations.text: vượt qua giai đoạn đau buồn

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To communicate successfully across a barrier; to make contact, or get one's point across; to reach the addressee, possibly with difficulty.

translations.text: nói cho người ta hiểu ra

examples.en: He was such a dyed-in-the-wool partisan that I just couldn't get through to him and change his mind.
examples.vi: Ông ta bè phái cố chấp đến mức tôi không tài nào nói cho ông ta hiểu và đổi ý được.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To begin (something); to get around to doing (something).

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To rise from one's bed, usually upon waking up in order to begin one's day.

examples.en: I didn't get up until midday.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To do something, especially something that is forbidden or improper.

examples.en: Recently he's been getting up to all sorts of mischief.
examples.vi: Dạo này nó bày đủ trò quậy phá.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To return, restore (a thing to its original owner or location etc.).

examples.en: Give me back my book!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To emit; to produce and send forth; to come across in some manner.

examples.en: The substance was giving off smoke.
examples.vi: Chất đó đang bốc khói.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To send forth, emit; to cause to be sent forth.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To surrender (someone or something); to inform on (someone).

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: to quickly inspect something (newspaper, notes) with the eyes

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To tackle (a problem or task).

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To pursue in attempt to catch another.

examples.en: The downed officer couldn't go after the criminal.
examples.vi: Viên cảnh sát bị thương gục xuống không thể đuổi theo tên tội phạm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be contrary to a trend, feeling or principle.

examples.en: This goes against my instincts.
examples.vi: Điều này trái với bản năng của tôi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: Used to grant permission for or to give endorsement of a suggestion or proposal.

examples.en: Go ahead and eat without me. I expect to be very late.
examples.vi: Cứ ăn trước đi, đừng đợi tôi. Chắc tôi sẽ về rất muộn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To resume something previously cancelled or delayed; to continue something despite known concerns.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To acquiesce to or comply with a proposal, despite lacking a desire or value for it.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To try to solve a problem a specific way; to undertake a task.

examples.en: I went at the issue for hours but could not come up with a way around it.
examples.vi: Tôi vật lộn với vấn đề đó hàng giờ mà không nghĩ ra cách gỡ.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To depart or leave a place.

examples.en: I'm not going to buy it. Please go away and don't come back.
examples.vi: Tôi không mua đâu. Làm ơn đi đi và đừng quay lại.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To return to a place or state after having been there at a previous time.

examples.en: We were getting cold so we decided to go back.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To know each other since long from.

examples.en: Bill and I go back to college.
examples.vi: Bill và tôi quen nhau từ thời đại học.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be more than (something); to be better than (something); to surpass (something).

examples.en: Last's night enjoyment went beyond my expectations.
examples.vi: Niềm vui tối qua vượt ngoài mong đợi của tôi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To follow; to assume as true for the purposes of making a decision, taking an action, etc.

examples.en: I'm only going by what my teacher said.
examples.vi: Tôi chỉ dựa vào những gì thầy giáo nói thôi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To undertake (an action); to choose an option.

examples.en: His phone was off and I couldn't ask his permission, so I decided to just go for it.
examples.vi: Điện thoại anh ấy tắt nên tôi không xin phép được, đành quyết làm luôn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To put maximum effort into achieving something.

examples.en: To win the competition he has to beat his personal best, and he's going for it.
examples.vi: Muốn thắng cuộc thi, anh ấy phải vượt thành tích tốt nhất của mình, và anh đang dốc toàn lực.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To begin clanging or making noise.

examples.en: The alarm will go off at six a.m.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To leave one's abode to go to public places, especially for recreation or entertainment.

examples.en: They were going to stay in and read, but instead went out shopping.
examples.vi: Họ định ở nhà đọc sách, nhưng rồi lại ra ngoài mua sắm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To go to another person's home or a public event.

examples.en: I went round and told him what I thought of him.
examples.vi: Tôi đã đến tận nhà và nói cho anh ta biết tôi nghĩ gì về anh ta.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To travel from one end of something to the other.

examples.en: The train went through the tunnel.
examples.vi: Tàu hỏa chạy xuyên qua đường hầm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To carry out (something planned or promised); to proceed with or continue with.

examples.en: If you decide to go through with the surgery, remember to leave time to recover.
examples.vi: Nếu quyết định phẫu thuật, nhớ dành thời gian để hồi phục.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be inseparable; to go hand in hand.

examples.en: Exercise and sweat often go together.
examples.vi: Tập thể dục và mồ hôi thường đi đôi với nhau.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To collapse or fail, e.g. by going bankrupt.

examples.en: In the crisis, the company was forced to reduce its costs in order to avoid going under.
examples.vi: Trong khủng hoảng, công ty buộc phải cắt giảm chi phí để khỏi phá sản.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To lack or be deprived of (something).

examples.en: The poor man's children went without supper.
examples.vi: Con cái của người đàn ông nghèo ấy phải nhịn bữa tối.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To continually absorb or expand through annexation.

translations.text: thâu tóm dần để bành trướng

examples.en: The city grew over the years by gobbling up land around its limits.
examples.vi: Qua nhiều năm, thành phố lớn lên nhờ nuốt dần vùng đất quanh ranh giới của nó.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To dawdle, lollygag; to waste time aimlessly or engage in idle activity or inactivity.

examples.en: He sat there goofing off all day instead of working.
examples.vi: Nó ngồi đó chơi bời cả ngày thay vì làm việc.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To grow in size, so as to be able to fit (something, especially an item of clothing).

examples.en: His new jumper was a bit big for him, but he'll grow into it in a couple of years.
examples.vi: Cái áo len mới hơi rộng, nhưng vài năm nữa thằng bé sẽ mặc vừa.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To become more likeable to someone.

translations.text: dần khiến người ta thấy thích

examples.vi: Một số doanh nghiệp đã chậm nhận ra tầm quan trọng của Internet.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To walk with no planned destination; to meander.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To come without an appointment to a place that would normally require one.

translations.text: đến thẳng mà không hẹn trước

examples.en: If you walk in, you're going to have to wait at least an hour.
examples.vi: Nếu đến mà không hẹn trước, bạn sẽ phải chờ ít nhất một tiếng.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To enter suddenly or unexpectedly while something is happening; to intrude or interrupt by entering.

translations.text: bất ngờ bước vào bắt gặp

examples.en: He accidentally walked in on me while I was undressing.
examples.vi: Anh ấy vô tình bước vào đúng lúc tôi đang cởi đồ.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To fall into (a trap or other situation), especially one that could have been avoided with more care.

examples.en: The platoon walked into an ambush.
examples.vi: Trung đội đã rơi vào ổ phục kích.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To recover from (a minor injury) or digest (a large meal) by walking around.

translations.text: đi lại một lúc cho đỡ

examples.en: It doesn't feel too bad. Let me walk it off.
examples.vi: Cũng không đau lắm. Để tôi đi lại một lúc cho đỡ.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To abandon or desert someone, especially a spouse.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To dominate, treat (someone) as inferior.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To wander away from somewhere.

examples.en: He got bored and wandered off.
examples.vi: Cậu ấy chán nên bỏ đi lang thang.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To want to enter something.

examples.en: Are you staying out there or do you want in?
examples.vi: Bạn định ở ngoài đó hay muốn vào?

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To desire to leave, quit or escape a specific situation, relationship, commitment, or project.

examples.en: After six months in a tedious desk job, Anna wants out.
examples.vi: Sau sáu tháng làm công việc bàn giấy tẻ nhạt, Anna muốn dứt ra.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To prepare for an activity by carrying out a practice or preparation routine.

examples.en: The band were already on stage, warming up for the gig.
examples.vi: Ban nhạc đã lên sân khấu, đang khởi động cho buổi diễn.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To eliminate or destroy by fast-moving water, such as a flood or a high sea.

examples.en: Thousands were left homeless as the flood waters washed away the eastern part of the city.
examples.vi: Hàng nghìn người mất nhà cửa khi nước lũ cuốn trôi khu phía đông thành phố.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To remove (or be removed) by washing; to clean off (dirt or the thing that it is besmirching) by washing.

examples.en: I'm trying to wash off this equipment.
examples.vi: Tôi đang cố rửa sạch bộ dụng cụ này.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To wash the inside of something.

examples.en: We must wash out the bins; they are full of maggots.
examples.vi: Phải cọ rửa mấy cái thùng thôi, bên trong đầy giòi.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To affect the emotions of (a person) suddenly and overwhelmingly.

examples.en: Embarrassment washed over me as I realized I had forgotten the notes for my presentation.
examples.vi: Nỗi xấu hổ trào lên trong tôi khi nhận ra mình đã quên ghi chú cho bài thuyết trình.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To guard and protect.

examples.en: She stayed up all night to watch over the sick infant.
examples.vi: Cô ấy thức trắng đêm trông đứa bé bị ốm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To simplify or oversimplify; to make easier; to make less difficult.

translations.text: đơn giản hóa cho dễ hơn

examples.en: If you plan to teach this material to children, you may need to water it down.
examples.vi: Nếu định dạy nội dung này cho trẻ em, có lẽ bạn cần đơn giản hóa nó.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To cause (someone) physical or mental fatigue.

examples.en: The eight hour shift in the mine began to wear Tim down after a few months.
examples.vi: Sau vài tháng, ca làm tám tiếng dưới mỏ bắt đầu khiến Tim kiệt sức.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To disappear because of being abraded, over-polished, or abused.

examples.en: The silver plating on that cheap silverware will wear off.
examples.vi: Lớp mạ bạc trên bộ dao nĩa rẻ tiền đó rồi sẽ mòn hết.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To assess a person or a situation.

translations.text: đánh giá, cân nhắc con người hay tình huống

examples.en: She looked at him carefully, trying to weigh him up. Was he really telling the truth?
examples.vi: Cô nhìn anh thật kỹ, cố đánh giá con người anh. Liệu anh có đang nói thật không?

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To gradually or steadily flow upwards or outwards so as to begin to fill or overflow something.

examples.en: Oil was welling up out of the borehole.
examples.vi: Dầu đang trào lên từ lỗ khoan.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To pull something out with a sudden jerk.

examples.en: He suddenly whipped out his gun and pointed it at his doctor.
examples.vi: Hắn bất ngờ rút phắt súng ra chĩa vào bác sĩ của mình.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To produce (something) quickly, especially food.

examples.en: I'll whip up a quick meal for our unexpected guests.
examples.vi: Tôi sẽ làm nhanh một bữa đãi mấy vị khách bất ngờ.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be victorious. Usually of emotions and human qualities.

examples.en: Love always wins out over hate.
examples.vi: Tình yêu luôn thắng hận thù.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To persuade someone, gain someone's support, or make someone understand the truth or validity of something.

translations.text: thuyết phục để giành được sự ủng hộ

examples.en: If the truth doesn't win him over, perhaps charm will.
examples.vi: Nếu sự thật không thuyết phục được anh ta, có lẽ sự duyên dáng sẽ làm được.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To relax; to get rid of stress; to destress.

examples.en: After a long day at work, she winds down by kickboxing.
examples.vi: Sau một ngày dài làm việc, cô ấy xả căng thẳng bằng cách tập kickboxing.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To play a prank (on); to take the mickey (out of) or mock.

examples.en: Twenty quid? Are you winding me up?
examples.vi: Hai mươi bảng á? Cậu đang đùa tôi đấy à?

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To remove or erase with a wiping motion.

examples.en: Let me wipe away your tears.
examples.vi: Để anh lau nước mắt cho em.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To clean the exterior surface of an object, from top to bottom, typically by hand using a damp dishcloth or other cleaning cloth.

examples.en: Please wipe down the kitchen appliances.
examples.vi: Làm ơn lau sạch các thiết bị nhà bếp.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To destroy completely, leaving no trace.

translations.text: xóa sạch không còn dấu vết

examples.en: Wipe that smile off your face!
examples.vi: Dẹp ngay nụ cười đó đi!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To bankrupt (a person or company); to empty (a bank account); to erase (a bank balance).

examples.en: They tried hard to hang on, but the Great Depression wiped them out.
examples.vi: Họ đã cố hết sức bám trụ, nhưng cuộc Đại Suy thoái khiến họ trắng tay.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To bypass or circumvent (a problem or obstacle).

translations.text: tìm cách lách qua trở ngại

examples.en: If we can't fix this problem, we'll just have to work around it.
examples.vi: Nếu không sửa được lỗi này, ta đành phải tìm cách lách qua nó.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To make a physical or mental effort to progress some specified task; to endeavor or struggle on an issue or project.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To find time or space for, amid other things.

examples.en: It'll be a tight schedule, but we can work you in.
examples.vi: Lịch sẽ khá kín, nhưng chúng tôi vẫn xếp cho bạn được.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To apply mental or physical effort to (something) in order to shape, form, improve, investigate, solve it, etc.

examples.en: John's in the studio working on the plans for the new house.
examples.vi: John đang ở xưởng, làm bản thiết kế cho ngôi nhà mới.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To succeed; to result in a satisfactory situation.

examples.en: Are you still seeing John? - No, it didn't work out.
examples.vi: Bạn vẫn đang hẹn hò với John chứ? - Không, chuyện không thành.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To get past a difficult or stressful situation by thinking or talking about it.

translations.text: trải lòng để vượt qua chuyện khó khăn

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To be coworkers with someone; to share a workspace with someone.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To cover or enclose (something) by folding and securing a covering entirely around it.

examples.en: He wrapped up the parcel with brown paper.
examples.vi: Anh ấy gói bưu kiện bằng giấy nâu.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To agonize over (something); to debate a quandary or endeavor to come to a conclusion about a difficult issue.

translations.text: trăn trở, vật lộn với một vấn đề

examples.en: I've been wrestling with your problem all night.
examples.vi: Tôi đã trăn trở về vấn đề của bạn suốt đêm.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To produce or set (something) down in writing; to record something.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To write at full length or in expanded form.

examples.en: Don't use abbreviations; write out words!
examples.vi: Đừng viết tắt, hãy viết đầy đủ các từ!

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To exclaim loudly.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To successfully narrow down a search (for).

examples.en: We have zeroed in on the source of the problem.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi đã khoanh được nguồn gốc của vấn đề.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To close with a zip fastener.

examples.en: Always check if you've zipped up your fly before you go out.
examples.vi: Trước khi ra ngoài, nhớ kiểm tra xem đã kéo khóa quần chưa.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote

meanings.text: To manipulate a display (such as a computer screen) so as to make the image larger.

examples.en: You can zoom in on the map to get a better view of the city.

source.attribution_text: English Wiktionary contributors (en.wiktionary.org), selected and translated for PomoQuote
